scope: Published metadata and ordinal-only conditional graph, not observed coordinates, not calibrated fish passage, not EOG predictive score

sources.facts: Common reaches section: numerical order increases upstream to downstream; Table 2 post-removal counts upper13 middle6 lower3; two former dams at article rkm7.9/21.4. 2018 management release below upper dam in reach14. Results already published, not blind.
Pinned XML Reach_ID ordered upstream to downstream, snorkeled length distinct from river kilometer boundary fields.

registry.edges: Assume one upstream edge between every adjacent ordered reach, e.g.22->21. This is an ordinal scaffold only; no actual adjacency, geometry, distances, flow speeds, or survey availability authenticated. No other barriers or demographic processes represented.
registry.source_note: 22 used as downstream-most ordinal entry proxy, not observed occupancy. Reach14 extra source represents a hypothetical effect of documented 2018 adult relocation, not allowed as a historical pre-removal source or presumed ongoing stock. No downstream movement in this explicit upstream-only model.

scenarios: All four binary passability combinations and both source policies; counterfactual structural conditions, not dated estimates or inferred actual permeability. Compare possible/robust projections across two source policies at each barrier setting.
estimand: Exact set of ordinal labels reachable in declared graph. For each target and source policy enumerate inclusion-minimal barrier openings from both closed; validate with independent formula based on rank intervals. No observed target or response is used.
stop: No raw fish values, measured GIS, cost or independent model validation; no fourth EOG-WF endpoint. 19/19/22/22 surveyed-reach counts do not identify exact missing IDs.
